title: Jeju Scent Library
subtitle: A meditative retreat of stone and fragrance.
line: Step into a silent sanctuary in Jeju where books are replaced by the delicate, lingering notes of Aesop fragrances.
quote: The silence of a library meets the scent of earth and time.
synopsis: You enter a room defined by textured strata clay walls that hold bottles like archived literature. In the absolute centre, a black volcanic stone basin serves as a meditative anchor where you pause to cleanse your hands. As you circle this quiet ritual, the scent of the Jeju earth and the gentle flow of water transport you into a realm of deep stillness. Finally, you move to the warm wooden counter at the back, completing your journey through this sensory archive.

why.d: Shelf walls (back library shelf wall) wrap the left, right and back of the 12 x 10 m room. These layered walls envelop you in the tactile essence of the island, creating a grounded, intimate library atmosphere.

The centre object (central meditative basin) is the first stop, 4.2 m in from the door. This central water feature offers an immediate sensory pause, inviting you to clear your mind and senses upon entry.
The route circles it first, then follows the shelves. The circulation forces a slow, contemplative pace that mirrors the reverence of an ancient library.
The counter (back service counter) sits at the back, off the loop. This final point of contact provides a grounding conclusion to your aromatic exploration within the space.
